purpose: Execute draft Section4.5 ExperimentB and Table5; descriptive laboratory warning sensitivity grid, historically inspected records, not blinded validation
comparison: strictly exceeds; equality is not an exceedance
rate_coverage: Complete 61 one-second grid temperatures spanning 60 elapsed seconds within one valid segment. Only past native samples are available.
grid: Integer seconds from ceil(raw start) to floor(raw end); use the most recent raw sample at or before each grid time, never future interpolation. Finite raw temperature, measurement age <=1.01 s, and a newly observed raw sample since the previous grid point are required. A raw gap >2 s or any nonfinite raw temperature starts a new segment; a gap >1.01 s also starts a new segment in Sheffield 1 Hz acquisition.
rate_units: OLS C/s times60 => C/min; no future samples or centered smoothing
debounce: Predicate remains true for 5 elapsed seconds on the sampled clock. False/nonfinite predicates or a segment change reset persistence. Use the first sample satisfying persistence; never backdate the alarm.
threshold_selection: User/draft sensitivity choices frozen before this scoring pass; never selected or optimized using missing event labels. Sheffield has 27 records, not 35 ARC/oven tests; its seven test records share two held-out dates.
tum_units: Six temperature channels, five voltage channels and five vent-temperature channels belong to one five-cell LFP module experiment; channels are dependent.
events: Audit source, physical definition, channel mapping, reference clock and uncertainty before any endpoint is eligible. Temperature-derived onset, heater startup and vent-temperature threshold crossing are not independent venting or TR labels. Edited video is not synchronized.

optional_voltage_condition.definition: First native voltage sample U<=0.1 V beginning a run confirmed for at least 5 elapsed seconds; reset for nonfinite samples or gaps >2 s. Require preheater baseline median 2.5–3.8 V from at least 10 finite samples and a preceding native sample >0.1 V. Save the bracket [previous above-threshold time, first at/below-threshold time]. This is a study-defined electrical condition, not TR onset or an independently observed vent event.
optional_voltage_condition.normal_context: Preheater (t<0) native median 2.5–3.8 V from >=10 finite samples; previous valid sample above 0.1 V. No parameter is adjusted after inspection.
optional_voltage_condition.clock: Paper describes voltage/thermocouples on a common CAN logger; source timestamps are retained. Observed channel phase offsets are not proof of absolute synchronization uncertainty. Without an independently auditable offset bound, arithmetic alarm-to-condition intervals are conditional and the physical reference remains unverified.

timing_policy: No TR lead time, miss rate, sensitivity or field false-alarm rate. Main Table 5 lead time remains UNAVAILABLE without an independently verified event clock, definition and uncertainty. Supplementary voltage-condition timing names its electrical endpoint and remains one experiment; external-heater alarms preceding it do not establish predictive warning.
forecast_screen: Optionally rescreen the Oct25 saved development-selected temperature-only forecasts with the same four fixed thresholds and 5 s debounce. Do not fit/refit or tune. Forecasts need 30 s past history; compare with current-temperature alarms on identical available origins. Report relative response timing, not TR lead time.
